Messages.Author: pallando
Messages.Body:
Hi,

Does the clause "in the first round of the resulting combat" apply to
"the blocking minion cannot strike to end combat"?

From the way it is worded, I'd say that the answer is no.

Name: Mind of the Wilds
[HttB:C]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Animalism & Auspex
[ani][aus] If this action is blocked, this vampire gets an optional
maneuver in the first round of the resulting combat, and the blocking
minion cannot strike to end combat.
[ANI][AUS] As above, with +1 stealth.

Kind regards,

pallando

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Mar 9, 1:45 pm, 3rdshiftr <pacificamer...@gmail.com> wrote:

> > > Does the clause "in the first round of the resulting combat" apply to
> > > "the blocking minion cannot strike to end combat"?

> > No.

> Sorry if I'm missing something, but what's the point of this card if
> the blocker CAN end combat in 1st round of combat?

You're right, you missed it.

Read as:

"If this action is blocked, ... the blocking minion cannot strike to
end combat."

i.e. the ending combat prohibiting is not restricted to any specific
round, it is continuous for the duration of the block attempt.
